android.releaseNotes:
• Apple-Grade iOS 26 Liquid Glass: Real shader-based optical refraction, chromatic aberration, and dynamic specular lighting across the floating navigation pill, chat screen headers, and input surfaces.
• Multi-Tonal Material You Dynamic Theming: Calibrated tonal elevation scale for system wallpapers with crisp contrast between scaffolds, cards, sheets, and interactive controls.
• Streamlined Core Architecture: Pruned duplicate canvas and capsule modules for enhanced performance and reduced memory footprint while keeping Dual Feeds, Vault Mode, and Couples Mode fully intact.
• WhatsApp/Instagram-Grade VoIP Calling & Signal Protocol E2EE.
